        "Apply the entire resultant P to one boundary node",
        "Apply an edge-midpoint force as P/2 at each of the two edge nodes",

        "Horizontal: P=(P0,0)",
        "60 degrees from +x: P=(P0/2,sqrt(3)P0/2)",

      "effect": "layout"

        "|P|=1 in consistent force units, inheriting the dataset convention",
        "|P|=100 in the same force units for an independently scaled illustration"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Maximum volume fraction f for Fig. 1",

      "description": "Sec. 2 leaves f symbolic. Sec. 5.1 gives a dataset range of 30%–50%, without choosing a value for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "f=0.30",
        "f=0.40",
        "f=0.50"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid or void elements",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 specifies density bounds but no passive-element masks, including whether material around loads and supports must remain solid.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive elements; all elements are design variables",
        "Keep the loaded cell and cells incident to supported nodes solid at density 1",
        "Keep solid patches two cells deep at the load and one cell deep along supported boundary portions"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0 used in optimization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 leaves E0 symbolic. Sec. 5.1 explicitly assigns unit modulus to finite-element field calculations, without stating whether this also defines the Fig. 1 optimization material.",
      "readings": [
        "E0=1 throughout the optimization and field calculations",
        "E0=200 GPa for optimization, with unit modulus used only for preprocessing fields"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio used in optimization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 gives no Poisson's ratio. Sec. 5.1 assigns 0.3 specifically when discussing finite-element field calculations; its applicability to Fig. 1 optimization is unstated.",
      "readings": [
        "ν=0.30 for optimization as well as preprocessing",
        "ν=0.25 for optimization, with ν=0.30 only for preprocessing",
        "ν=0.35 for optimization, with ν=0.30 only for preprocessing"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Planar constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The planar grid and x/y constraints in Sec. 5.1 do not determine whether the finite-element constitutive matrix uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness is supplied for a planar interpretation of Fig. 1. For a fixed total force and uniform thickness, this changes compliance scaling.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness: t=1 length unit",
        "Thin plate: t=0.01W"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Minimum stiffness Emin relative to E0",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 describes Emin as small and approximately 0.001E0, rather than giving an exact ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/E0=0.001",
        "Emin/E0=0.0005",
        "Emin/E0=0.002"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP exponent p for Fig. 1",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 introduces p without a value. Sec. 5.1 specifies p=3 for dataset generation but does not explicitly establish that Fig. 1 uses that configuration.",
      "readings": [
        "p=3, inheriting the dataset setting",
        "p=2 for a separate illustrative optimization",
        "p=4 for a separate illustrative optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter radius and its units",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 leaves r_min symbolic. Sec. 5.1 reports radius 2.0 for the dataset without specifying its length units or explicitly applying it to Fig. 1. Here h is the element side length.",
      "readings": [
        "r_min=2h, inheriting a radius of two element widths",
        "r_min=2 physical length units on a domain normalized to W=1",
        "r_min=1.5h for a separate illustrative optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Meaning of the filter weight in Eq. (6)",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 2 defines x_i and x_e as densities, so Eq. (6) literally weights density differences. The surrounding discussion of nearby elements and filter radius also supports interpreting the difference as spatial distance.",
      "readings": [
        "Literal density-dependent weight: w_ei=r_min-|ρ_i-ρ_e|",
        "Spatial weight: w_ei=r_min-d_ei, where d_ei is distance between element centers"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Membership of filter neighborhood N_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 uses N_e in Eq. (7) without defining its distance metric, stencil, or whether the element itself belongs to its neighborhood.",
      "readings": [
        "Include e and all element centers within Euclidean distance r_min",
        "Include e and all element centers within a square neighborhood defined by max(|ΔX|,|ΔY|)<r_min",
        "Exclude e and include only other element centers within Euclidean distance r_min"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (7) does not specify how neighborhoods are handled when they extend beyond the domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate neighborhoods to existing elements and renormalize their weights",
        "Extend densities by reflection across the boundary before filtering",
        "Use zero-valued padding and include padded locations in the normalization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Use of design and physical densities in stiffness and volume",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eqs. (1) and (4) use x, while Eq. (7) introduces physical density tilde-x without explicitly connecting it to stiffness or volume. The claimed preservation of volume is not generally guaranteed by local normalization alone.",
      "readings": [
        "Use filtered densities for both stiffness and volume; constrain sum(tilde-x_e v_e)",
        "Use filtered densities for stiffness but raw design densities for the volume constraint",
        "Correct filtered densities within [0,1] to preserve their total volume, then use the corrected densities for stiffness and volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Grid resolution for Fig. 1",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 supplies no element counts. Sec. 5.1 specifies 64×64 square elements for dataset samples, without explicitly identifying the Fig. 1 mesh.",
      "readings": [
        "64×64 square elements, inheriting the dataset grid",
        "32×32 square elements for a standalone square-domain illustration",
        "128×128 square elements for a standalone square-domain illustration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 specifies finite elements and Sec. 5.1 specifies square elements, but neither gives the displacement interpolation order or stiffness integration rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with stabilized one-point integration",
        "Eight-node serendipity quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial design densities",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 describes iterative density updates without specifying the initial field. Sec. 5.1's initial unoptimized domain is discussed for preprocessing, not explicitly as the optimizer initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every free element at x_e=f",
        "Initialize every free element at x_e=1",
        "Initialize at f plus a deterministic zero-mean alternating perturbation of magnitude 0.01"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Gradient-descent update and volume-constraint enforcement",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 mentions gradient updates and Sec. 5.1 calls the optimizer gradient descent, but neither specifies how descent enforces the volume constraint and density bounds.",
      "readings": [
        "Projected gradient descent onto the density bounds and volume-feasible set",
        "Gradient descent on a Lagrangian, adjusting the volume multiplier at each iteration",
        "Augmented-Lagrangian gradient descent with multiplier and penalty updates"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization step size and move limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No topology-optimization learning rate, line search, or density move limit is given in Secs. 2 or 5.1. Sec. 6.1's AdamW settings concern neural-network training.",
      "readings": [
        "Fixed step size 0.01, followed by feasibility enforcement, with no additional move limit",
        "Armijo backtracking starting at step size 1, with maximum density change 0.2 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization stopping rule",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says updates continue until convergence but provides no convergence measure, tolerance, or iteration cap.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.001, with a cap of 200 iterations",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 0.0001 for five iterations, with a cap of 1000 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Accuracy of finite-element equilibrium solves",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) specifies KU=F but gives no numerical solution accuracy for the repeated analyses.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct solves to near machine precision",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Compliance normalization",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 2 calls compliance the total strain energy, while Eq. (2) defines U^T K U, which is twice the linear-elastic strain energy.",
      "readings": [
        "c=U^T K U, following Eq. (2)",
        "c=(1/2)U^T K U, following the strain-energy wording"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    }
  ]
}
